bot.plan.title.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a project's first version. The bot speaks in the first person. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.titleUnnamed.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a project's first version, when the project's name is not known. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.plan.titleRequest.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a change a person asked for on a project that already runs. The bot speaks in the first person. {{title}} is the request's title.

bot.plan.titleRequestUntitled.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a change a person asked for on a project that already runs, when the request's title is not known. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.plan.titleInApp.description: Title of Homeroom bot's plan card when it is shown on the project's own page; the plan's lines follow, so keep the colon. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.titleInAppUnnamed.text: Here’s my plan for your project:
bot.plan.titleInAppUnnamed.description: Title of Homeroom bot's plan card when it is shown on the project's own page and the project's name is not known; the plan's lines follow, so keep the colon.

bot.plan.name.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's plan card. "Plan" is a noun. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.nameUnnamed.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's plan card when the project's name is not known. "Plan" is a noun.

bot.plan.replaced.description: Line on an older plan card from Homeroom bot once the bot has sent a newer plan for the same project.

bot.plan.build.description: Main button on Homeroom bot's plan card: tells the bot to build what the plan describes. "Build" is a verb.

bot.plan.change.description: Secondary button on Homeroom bot's plan card: lets the person write what to change in the plan. "Change" is a verb.

bot.plan.building.description: Tooltip of the small spinning ring beside "Building it" on Homeroom bot's plan card.

bot.plan.state.built.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card after the person pressed "Build it": the bot is building what the plan describes.

bot.plan.state.stopped.text: I stopped waiting on this plan. Reply to pick it up again.
bot.plan.state.stopped.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card when nobody answered it for a week. The bot speaks in the first person; replying in the conversation revives the plan.

bot.plan.state.changing.text: You asked for changes. A new plan is on its way.
bot.plan.state.changing.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card after the person asked for something to be changed in it.

bot.plan.state.closed.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card once the plan no longer applies.

bot.questions.suggested.description: Small tag beside the first answer to one of Homeroom bot's questions: the answer the bot recommends. Lower case.

bot.questions.actions.description: Accessible name of the pair of buttons under Homeroom bot's two questions (Build it, Something else). A noun.

bot.questions.send.description: Button under Homeroom bot's two questions about a request: sends the chosen answers to the bot. It does not start building; "Send" is a verb.

bot.questions.writeOwn.description: Button under Homeroom bot's questions: lets the person type their own answers instead of choosing them.

bot.questions.youAnswered.description: Shown under Homeroom bot's questions after the person answered. {{answers}} is their answers, one per line; keep the line break after the colon.

bot.questions.closed.description: Line under Homeroom bot's questions once they no longer apply.

botCards.failed.text: That did not go through. Try again.
botCards.failed.description: Line on a card under a reply from Homeroom bot (options, questions) when a tap could not be sent.

botCards.options.label.description: Small label at the top of a card of options Homeroom bot offers to pick from (shown in capitals).

botCards.options.show.description: Button under one option on Homeroom bot's options card: asks the bot to show or explain that option. A verb.

botCards.options.pick.description: Button under one option on Homeroom bot's options card: chooses that option and tells the bot. A verb.

botCards.options.showNamed.description: Accessible name of the Show button under one option on Homeroom bot's options card. {{key}} is the option's letter (A to D), {{title}} its title.

botCards.options.pickNamed.description: Accessible name of the Pick button under one option on Homeroom bot's options card. {{key}} is the option's letter (A to D), {{title}} its title.

botCards.options.picked.description: Shown, with a check, under the option the person picked on Homeroom bot's options card.

botCards.options.showSay.description: Sent as the person's own message to Homeroom bot when they tap Show under an option. {{key}} is the option's letter (A to D), {{title}} its title.

botCards.options.pickSay.description: Sent as the person's own message to Homeroom bot when they tap Pick under an option: their choice. {{key}} is the option's letter (A to D), {{title}} its title.

botCards.questions.label.description: Small label at the top of a card of questions Homeroom bot asks, answered together (shown in capitals).

botCards.questions.other.description: Placeholder of the field under one of Homeroom bot's questions, for an answer of the person's own instead of a suggested one.

botCards.questions.otherNamed.description: Accessible name of the field for an answer of one's own under one of Homeroom bot's questions. {{number}} is the question's number on the card.

botCards.questions.send.description: Button on Homeroom bot's questions card: sends the chosen answers to the bot. "Send" is a verb.

botCards.questions.youDecide.description: Button on Homeroom bot's questions card: leaves the answers to the bot.

botCards.questions.youDecideSay.description: Sent as the person's own message to Homeroom bot when they tap You decide on its questions card: the bot picks the answers.

botCards.questions.answerLine.description: One line of the message sent as the person when they send their answers to Homeroom bot's questions, one line per question. {{number}} is the question's number, {{answer}} their answer.

botCards.questions.skipped.text: You left these to Homeroom bot.
botCards.questions.skipped.description: Shown, with a check, on Homeroom bot's questions card once the person tapped You decide.

botCards.table.tag.ready.description: Small label on a row of a table Homeroom bot shows: the request is ready to build or to try.

botCards.table.tag.question.description: Small label on a row of a table Homeroom bot shows: the request waits on a question.

botCards.table.tag.done.description: Small label on a row of a table Homeroom bot shows: the request is done.

botCards.table.tag.stopped.description: Small label on a row of a table Homeroom bot shows: work on the request stopped.

botCards.table.tagHeading.description: Accessible name of the last column of a table Homeroom bot shows, the column of small labels such as Ready or Done. Read by screen readers only.

botCards.table.openRequest.description: Tooltip of a row of a table Homeroom bot shows, when the row is about a request: opens the request's page. {{project}} is the project's name, {{number}} the request's number.

botCards.table.more_one.description: Under a table Homeroom bot shows, when it left rows out. {{count}} is how many.

botCards.table.more_other.description: Under a table Homeroom bot shows, when it left rows out. {{count}} is how many.

botCards.looked.summary_one.description: Quiet line above a reply from Homeroom bot that opens to the list of what it read to answer. {{count}} is how many things; {{time}} is how long the answer took, such as "40 s".

botCards.looked.summary_other.description: Quiet line above a reply from Homeroom bot that opens to the list of what it read to answer. {{count}} is how many things; {{time}} is how long the answer took, such as "40 s".

botCards.looked.summaryNoTime_one.description: Quiet line above a reply from Homeroom bot that opens to the list of what it read to answer, when how long it took is not known. {{count}} is how many things.

botCards.looked.summaryNoTime_other.description: Quiet line above a reply from Homeroom bot that opens to the list of what it read to answer, when how long it took is not known. {{count}} is how many things.

botCards.looked.seconds_one.description: How long Homeroom bot took to answer, in seconds, in the line "Looked at 5 things · 40 s". Short: an abbreviation of seconds.

botCards.looked.seconds_other.description: How long Homeroom bot took to answer, in seconds, in the line "Looked at 5 things · 40 s". Short: an abbreviation of seconds.

botCards.looked.minutes_one.description: How long Homeroom bot took to answer, in minutes, in the line "Looked at 5 things · 2 min". Short: an abbreviation of minutes.

botCards.looked.minutes_other.description: How long Homeroom bot took to answer, in minutes, in the line "Looked at 5 things · 2 min". Short: an abbreviation of minutes.

botCards.looked.list.description: Accessible name of the list under the line "Looked at 5 things", of what Homeroom bot read to answer.

bot.question.fileRequest.description: Accessible name of the buttons under Homeroom bot's offer to file a request on the person's behalf, when the bot gave no question of its own. "File" is a verb: to submit the request.

bot.question.suggestedAnswers.description: Accessible name of the group of answer buttons under a question from Homeroom bot.

bot.question.suggested.description: Small tag beside the first answer button under a question from Homeroom bot: the answer the bot recommends. Lower case.

bot.question.writeOwn.description: Button under a question from Homeroom bot: lets the person type their own answer instead of choosing one.

bot.question.youChose.description: Shown under Homeroom bot's offer after the person pressed one of its buttons. {{answer}} is the label of the button they pressed.

bot.question.youAnswered.description: Small label above the answer the person gave to a question from Homeroom bot.

bot.question.closed.description: Line under a question from Homeroom bot once it no longer applies.

bot.actions.questionsYouCanAsk.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when each button is a question the person can ask it.

bot.actions.whatNext.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when they are suggestions for a next step.

bot.actions.choices.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when they are choices to pick from.

bot.actions.youAsked.description: Shown under a message from Homeroom bot after the person pressed one of its suggested questions. {{question}} is the question they pressed.

bot.actions.youChose.description: Shown under a message from Homeroom bot after the person pressed one of its buttons. {{choice}} is the label of the button they pressed.

bot.actions.closed.description: Line under a message from Homeroom bot whose buttons no longer apply.

bot.make.title.description: Heading of the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card. "Make" is a verb.

bot.make.close.description: Accessible name of the X button of the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: closes it without making anything.

bot.make.nameLabel.description: Label of the project's name field in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card; it starts with the name the bot suggested.

bot.make.audienceLabel.description: Label over the three choices of who the new project is for, in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card.

bot.make.audience.solo.description: One of the three choices of who the new project is for, in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: only the person.

bot.make.audience.invited.description: One of the three choices of who the new project is for, in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: the person and the people they invite.

bot.make.audience.open.description: One of the three choices of who the new project is for, in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: anyone on Homeroom.

bot.make.audienceHint.solo.text: Only you can see it and change it.
bot.make.audienceHint.solo.description: The line under "Just you" in the sheet that makes a new project from a design.

bot.make.audienceHint.invited.text: You and the people you invite.
bot.make.audienceHint.invited.description: The line under "Private community" in the sheet that makes a new project from a design.

bot.make.audienceHint.open.text: Anyone on Homeroom can see it and join.
bot.make.audienceHint.open.description: The line under "Public community" in the sheet that makes a new project from a design.

bot.make.note.text: Homeroom bot builds its first version from this design and tells you here when it's live.
bot.make.note.description: The line above the button of the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: what happens after it is made.

bot.make.submit.description: The button of the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card: makes the project. "Make" is a verb.

bot.make.making.description: The button of the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card while the project is being made.

bot.make.error.text: The project could not be made just now. Try again in a minute.
bot.make.error.description: Shown in the sheet that makes a new project from a design Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) drew with the person in a private thread, opened by "Make the project" under the bot's card when making the project failed for a reason that was not said.

bot.make.open.description: Link under Homeroom bot's card once the person made a new project from a design: opens the project they made, by its name.

bot.posted.answer.firstVersion.text: Your answer is posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.firstVersion.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.answer.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your answer is posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.answer.request.text: Your answer is posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.request.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.answer.requestUnnamed.text: Your answer is posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.requestUnnamed.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.posted.answers.firstVersion.text: Your answers are posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.firstVersion.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.answers.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your answers are posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.answers.request.text: Your answers are posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.request.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.answers.requestUnnamed.text: Your answers are posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.requestUnnamed.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.posted.reply.firstVersion.text: Your reply is posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.firstVersion.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.reply.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your reply is posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.reply.request.text: Your reply is posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.request.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.reply.requestUnnamed.text: Your reply is posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.requestUnnamed.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.draft.reply.text: Your reply stays in this chat until you tap Post it.
bot.draft.reply.description: Small note under the reply being written, in the person's private chat with Homeroom bot, when the reply answers one of the bot's questions or asks about a request: the chat is private, so the reply is not posted on the request's public discussion until the person taps the Post it button the bot puts under its answer. "Post it" is that button's label.

bot.thanks.usually.description: Note beside "Building" on the card Homeroom bot sends after the person approved its plan: the usual range of time a build takes. {{from}} and {{to}} are numbers of minutes; "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.thanks.unnamedProject.description: Stands in for the project's name on the card Homeroom bot sends after the person approved its plan, when the name is not known.

bot.notify.offer.description: Button under Homeroom bot's plan while it builds: asks for a phone notification when the build is ready to try.

bot.notify.done.description: Shown in place of the "Notify me when it’s ready" button once notifications are allowed. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.notify.off.description: Shown in place of the "Notify me when it’s ready" button when the phone refused notifications for Homeroom.

bot.notify.groupName.description: Accessible name of the group holding the "Notify me when it’s ready" button under Homeroom bot's plan.

bot.notify.turnOn.description: Button shown when notifications are off for Homeroom on this phone: opens the phone's notification settings.

bot.notify.liveOn.text: We’ll tell you when it’s live
bot.notify.liveOn.description: Switch under Homeroom bot's plan for a new project's first version, shown with a check while it is on (it starts on): the person is notified when the first version goes live. Tapping it turns it off.

bot.notify.liveOff.description: The same switch once the person turned it off: tapping it turns notifications for the first version going live back on.

composer.attachLimit_one.text: You can attach up to {{count}} file.
composer.attachLimit_one.description: Error under the message box when more files were chosen than one message can carry. {{count}} is the most files a message can have.

composer.attachLimit_other.text: You can attach up to {{count}} files.
composer.attachLimit_other.description: Error under the message box when more files were chosen than one message can carry. {{count}} is the most files a message can have.

composer.fileTooLarge.text: {{file}} is too large for this file type.
composer.fileTooLarge.description: Error under the message box when a chosen file is over the size allowed for its kind. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.uploadFailed.description: Error under the message box when attaching a file failed and the server gave no reason. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.sendFailed.description: Error under the message box when sending failed and the server gave no reason.

composer.requestSent.title.description: Heading shown in place of the message box after your first message to someone who has not accepted a conversation with you yet. A "message request" is that first message, which they must accept.

composer.requestSent.waitingNamed.text: Waiting for {{username}} to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingNamed.description: Notice in place of the message box of a direct message whose first message was sent as a message request. {{username}} is the other person's username, written bare as a direct message names people (#4655).

composer.requestSent.waitingUnknown.text: Waiting for unknown to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingUnknown.description: Notice in place of the message box of a direct message whose first message was sent as a message request, when the other person's username did not come with the conversation. "unknown" stands where the username would be, written bare as a direct message names people.

composer.requestSent.waitingUnnamed.text: Waiting for them to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingUnnamed.description: Text under "Message request sent", in place of the message box, when the other person's username is not known.

composer.cannotSend.text: You can’t send messages in this conversation.
composer.cannotSend.description: Shown in place of the message box in a conversation the person may read but not write in.

composer.firstMessageHintNamed.text: {{username}} gets your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintNamed.description: Line above the message box of a new direct message to someone who has not accepted you yet. {{username}} is their username, written bare as a direct message names people (#4655).

composer.firstMessageHintUnknown.text: unknown gets your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintUnknown.description: Line above the message box of a new direct message when the other person's username did not come with the conversation. "unknown" stands where the username would be, written bare as a direct message names people.

composer.firstMessageHintUnnamed.text: They get your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintUnnamed.description: Hint above the message box before your first message to someone who has not talked with you before, when their username is not known.

composer.replyingTo.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. {{name}} is the author of that message, as shown in the conversation (for a person, their username with @).

composer.replyingToUnknownHandle.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

composer.replyingToUnknown.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

composer.replyAttachment.description: Shown in the reply bar above the message box in place of the quoted message's words when that message is only a file or picture. A noun.

composer.planReplyNote.text: Say what to change, and Homeroom bot sends a new plan. Only you see this.
composer.planReplyNote.description: Note in the reply bar while replying to the plan for a project's first version from Homeroom bot: the reply is read by the bot alone, which sends a new plan. Homeroom bot is the assistant's name. "Change" is a verb.

composer.planReplyNotePublic.text: What you write is posted on the request, where the group can see it.
composer.planReplyNotePublic.description: Note in the reply bar while replying to Homeroom bot's plan for a request on an existing project: the reply is posted on the request's public discussion.

composer.cancelReply.description: Accessible name of the × button on the reply bar above the message box: stops replying to that message and keeps the text typed.

composer.removeSharedItem.description: Accessible name of the × button on an item (an app, a request, a change) staged in the message box to be shared with the message.

composer.removeAttachment.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file attached to the message being written. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.uploading_one.description: Shown beside the attached files in the message box while files upload. {{count}} is how many are still uploading.

composer.uploading_other.description: Shown beside the attached files in the message box while files upload. {{count}} is how many are still uploading.

composer.channelsMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of channels suggested while typing # in the message box.

composer.peopleMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of people suggested while typing @ in the message box.

composer.emojiMatching.description: Heading of the list of emoji suggested while typing a shortcode such as ":smile" in the message box. {{query}} is what was typed after the colon; keep the colon before it. The tags style the typed text.

composer.emojiMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of emoji suggested while typing a shortcode in the message box.

composer.addToMessage.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the + button beside the message box, and name of the menu it opens (attach files, share an item).

composer.attachFiles.description: Item in the + menu beside the message box: opens the file chooser to attach files to the message.

composer.shareItem.description: Item in the + menu beside the message box: opens a dialog to pick an app, request or change from Homeroom to send with the message. "Share" is a verb.

composer.placeholderThread.description: Greyed hint inside the empty message box of a reply thread in Messages or a channel. "Reply" is a verb; keep the ellipsis.

composer.placeholderBotThread.description: Placeholder in the message box of a request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot. The thread's header above names the request, so the placeholder does not; keep it short enough for one line on a phone.

composer.placeholderBotThreadFirstVersio.description: Placeholder in the message box of the thread about a project's first version in the chat with Homeroom bot. The thread's header above names the project; keep it short enough for one line on a phone.

composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the message box of a conversation. A noun: write a message here.

composer.labelThread.description: Accessible label of the message box of a thread.

composer.label.description: Accessible label of the message box of a conversation. A noun.

composer.send.description: Accessible name of the arrow button beside the message box: sends the message.

composer.format.bar.description: Accessible name of the row of formatting buttons above a community channel's message box; it groups the six buttons that format the message being written.

composer.format.bold.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: makes the selected text bold, or starts bold text at the cursor. Pressing it again removes the bold.

composer.format.italic.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: makes the selected text italic, or starts italic text at the cursor. Pressing it again removes the italic.

composer.format.underline.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: underlines the selected text, or starts underlined text at the cursor. Pressing it again removes the underline.

composer.format.heading.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: turns the cursor's line into a heading, and pressing it again steps through large, medium and small before plain text.

composer.format.quote.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: turns the selected lines, or the cursor's line, into a quote. Pressing it again removes the quote.

composer.format.bullets.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a formatting button above a channel's message box: turns the selected lines, or the cursor's line, into bullet points. Pressing it again removes the bullets.

composer.format.preview.description: Small label and accessible name of the live preview inside a community channel's message box: it shows the message being written with its formatting applied, as it will look once sent.

object.kind.app.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message, and on the item waiting in the message box: the item is an app.

object.kind.issue.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a request, a filed ask for a change to a project. A noun.

object.kind.proposal.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a change, a built proposal to modify a project. A noun.

object.kind.governance.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

object.kind.spec.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is one version of a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do.

object.kind.hub.description: Small label on a card for a link shared in a message: the link leads to a community's hub page.

object.kind.discussion.description: Small label on a card for a link shared in a message: the link leads to a project's discussion channel. A noun.

object.kind.unknown.description: Stands in for the kind of thing staged in the message box to be shared when its kind is not recognised. A noun.

object.requestNumber.description: Small label on a card for a request shared in a message. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

object.unavailable.title.description: Title of the card shown in place of a shared item the reader has no access to.

object.unavailable.detail.description: Second line of the card shown in place of a shared item the reader has no access to.

object.untitled.description: Title on a card for a shared item that has no title of its own.

object.byAuthor.description: One fact in the dot-separated detail line of a card for a shared item, complete on its own: who created the item. It is joined to the other facts (the project, the item's status) by a middle dot. {{author}} is a username.

object.fromProject.description: On a card for a request, change or other item shared in a project's channel, when the item belongs to a different project than the channel's: says which project it comes from. {{project}} is that project's name. Joined to the item's status with a middle dot, for example "From KasirKU · open".

channel.backCommunities.description: Label of the back control on the #general channel when it leads to the Communities screen.

thread.jumpToLatest.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation: scrolls down to the newest message.

thread.jumpToLatestNew_one.description: Accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation when messages arrived while the reader was scrolled up. {{count}} is how many arrived.

thread.jumpToLatestNew_other.description: Accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation when messages arrived while the reader was scrolled up. {{count}} is how many arrived.

thread.newMessages_one.description: Banner at the top of a conversation opened with unread messages: pressing it jumps to the first unread one. {{count}} is how many are unread.

thread.newMessages_other.description: Banner at the top of a conversation opened with unread messages: pressing it jumps to the first unread one. {{count}} is how many are unread.

refCard.open.description: Title of the card under a message that mentions a request by number, when the request's own title could not be loaded. "Open" is a verb.

store.you.description: Stands in for the signed-in person's username on a message they just sent, when the username is not known.

store.error.awaitingAcceptance.text: They need to accept your message request before you can send more.
store.error.awaitingAcceptance.description: Error in a conversation when a second message was sent before the other person accepted the first one (the message request).

store.error.gone.text: This conversation is no longer available.
store.error.gone.description: Error shown in place of a conversation that was deleted or that the person can no longer see.

store.error.tooFast.text: You’re doing that too quickly. Try again in a moment.
store.error.tooFast.description: Error in Messages when the server refused an action because too many were made in a short time.

store.error.loadList.description: Error in place of the conversation list in Messages when it could not be fetched.

store.error.loadThread.description: Error in place of a conversation's messages when they could not be fetched.

store.error.loadNewer.description: Error in a conversation when fetching the next, newer page of messages failed.

store.error.loadOlder.description: Error in a conversation when fetching the previous, older page of messages failed.

store.error.discussion.text: This discussion could not be opened.
store.error.discussion.description: Error in Messages when a project's discussion channel could not be opened.

store.error.queued.text: Message queued. It will retry when you reconnect.
store.error.queued.description: Notice in a conversation when a message was written while offline: it is kept and sent when the connection returns.

store.error.send.description: Error in a conversation when sending a message failed and the server gave no reason.

store.error.sendReply.description: Error in a thread when sending a reply failed and the server gave no reason.

store.error.loadReplies.description: Error in place of a thread's replies when they could not be fetched.

store.error.loadEarlierReplies.description: Error in a thread when fetching the earlier page of replies failed.

store.header.channel.description: Title in the app header while a project's channel is open and its name is not known yet. A noun.

store.header.thread.description: Title in the app header on a phone while a thread of replies is open. A noun.

store.header.discussion.description: Title in the app header while a project's discussion is open in Messages and its name is not known yet. A noun.

store.header.messages.description: Title in the app header on the Messages screen, and for a conversation that has no title.

store.header.main.description: Title over Main Chat, the person's private chat with Homeroom bot: the first row of the AI tab's list, which opens it, and over it in the column beside that list and in the AI tab's drawer on a phone. A name, like a channel's.

store.askForChangesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the message box of the chat with Homeroom bot after pressing "Change something" on a change, or "Tell Homeroom bot what to change" on a project's Hub: the person types what they want changed. "Change" is a verb.

api.deletedUser.description: Stands in for the author's username on a quoted message whose author's account no longer exists.

api.unknownUser.description: Stands where a username would be, for an account whose username did not come from the server. Shown alone, sometimes after an @. Lower case; keep it one short word.

store.error.groupNeedsName.description: Brief message shown when a person renames a group chat and leaves the name empty.

store.error.groupNameTooLong.text: Group names can be up to 80 characters.
store.error.groupNameTooLong.description: Brief message shown when a person renames a group chat with a name longer than 80 characters.

store.error.chooseConversation.description: Error line in the "Share to…" dialog when what was picked is not a conversation that can be shared to.

api.conversationTitle.description: Title of a conversation that has no name and whose other member is not known. A noun.

api.requestFailed.description: Error in Messages when a request to the server failed and the server gave no explanation. "Request" is a noun, the network request. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

api.contactRestricted.text: This person only takes new messages and invitations from people in projects with them. You can send them an invite link instead.
api.contactRestricted.description: Error in Messages when you try to start a conversation with someone, or invite them to a group, and their Privacy setting allows that only from people who share a project with them. It must not say anything else about the person.

api.uploadFailed.description: Error under the message box when uploading an attachment failed and the server gave no explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

api.untitledItem.description: Title of a request or change in the "Share item" list when it has no title of its own.

api.approve.unreachable.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when approving the change failed because the server could not be reached. Homeroom is the product's name.

api.approve.failed.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when approving the change failed and the server gave no reason.

api.approve.notBuilder.text: Only the people building this project can approve it. You can still try it.
api.approve.notBuilder.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when someone who does not build on the project tapped Approve.

api.withdraw.unreachable.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when withdrawing the change failed because the server could not be reached. Homeroom is the product's name.

api.withdraw.failed.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when withdrawing the change failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.direct.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when starting a direct conversation failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.group.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when creating a group chat failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.unblock.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when unblocking a person failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.block.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when blocking a person failed and the server gave no reason.

create.block.title.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking a person, so they can no longer message you. "Block" is a verb. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

create.block.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking a person, so they can no longer message you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

create.block.message.text: Their messages in shared chats and app discussions will be hidden, and they won’t be able to message you directly.
create.block.message.description: Body of the confirmation before blocking a person: what blocking does.

create.block.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before blocking a person. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

create.title.description: Title of the dialog for starting a conversation with a person or creating a group chat.

create.typeTabs.description: Accessible name of the two tabs in the "New message" dialog that choose between a direct conversation and a group.

create.tab.direct.description: Tab in the "New message" dialog: start a one-to-one conversation. Short for "direct message".

create.tab.group.description: Tab in the "New message" dialog: create a group chat. A noun.

create.groupName.description: Label of the field for the new group chat's name in the "New message" dialog.

create.groupNamePlaceholder.description: Example of a group chat name, shown as the placeholder of the "Group name" field.

create.selectedMembers.description: Accessible name of the row of people chosen so far for a new group chat.

create.findPerson.description: Label of the search field in the "New message" dialog when starting a direct conversation.

create.invitePeople.description: Label of the search field in the "New message" dialog when creating a group chat.

create.inviteNote.text: Note for the people you invite (optional)
create.inviteNote.description: Label of the optional note field in the New message dialog's Group tab, under the group name: a short line the invited people read on their invitation.

create.inviteNotePlaceholder.text: Why you’re adding them, or what the group is for
create.inviteNotePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the optional note field in the New message dialog's Group tab.

create.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the people search field in the "New message" dialog.

create.result.add.description: Action shown on a person in the search results while creating a group chat: pressing the row adds them to the group.

create.result.message.description: Action shown on a person in the search results of the "New message" dialog: pressing the row opens a direct conversation with them. A verb.

create.result.blockNamed.description: Accessible name of the "Block" button beside a person in the search results. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

create.result.blockUnknown.description: Accessible name of the "Block" button beside a person in the search results. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

create.result.block.description: Button beside a person in the search results of the "New message" dialog. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

create.blockedPeople.description: Link at the foot of the "New message" dialog that shows the list of people you have blocked, and the heading of that list.

create.creating.description: Label of the "Create group" button while the group chat is being created.

create.createGroup.description: Button in the "New message" dialog: creates the group chat with the chosen name and people.

create.nobodyBlocked.description: Shown in the "Blocked people" list when you have not blocked anyone.

create.unblock.description: Button beside a person in the "Blocked people" list: lets them message you again.

create.searching.description: Shown under the people search field in the "New message" dialog while results load.

create.noMatches.description: Shown under the people search field in the "New message" dialog when nobody matches what was typed.

members.error.invite.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when inviting people failed and the server gave no reason.

members.error.remove.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when removing someone failed and the server gave no reason.

members.error.leave.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when leaving the group failed and the server gave no reason.

members.remove.title.description: Title of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

members.remove.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

members.remove.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat.

members.leave.transfer.text: Ownership will transfer to the oldest remaining member.
members.leave.transfer.description: Body of the confirmation shown to a group chat's owner before they leave it: the member who joined earliest becomes the owner.

members.leave.title.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member. {{group}} is the group chat's name.

members.leave.titleUntitled.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member. Used for a conversation that has no name and whose other member is not known; "Conversation" is written as the title has always shown it.

members.leave.titleUnnamed.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat that has no name. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member.

members.leave.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. A verb: stop being a member.

members.title.description: Title of the dialog that lists the people in a group chat.

members.subtitle.text: Accepted members can read the complete retained history.
members.subtitle.description: Line under the "Group members" title: people who accepted their invitation can read all messages the group still keeps, including older ones.

members.role.owner.description: Role shown under a person's name in the "Group members" list: the person who owns the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.role.member.description: Role shown under a person's name in the "Group members" list: an ordinary member of the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.status.invited.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they were invited and have not accepted yet. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.status.declined.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they turned the invitation down. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.status.left.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they left the group chat (past tense of "leave"). Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.status.removed.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they were removed from the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.removeButton.description: Button beside a member in the "Group members" list: removes that person from the group chat.

members.invitePeople.description: Label of the search field in the "Group members" dialog for adding more people to the group chat.

members.inviteNote.text: Note for the people you invite (optional)
members.inviteNote.description: Label of the optional note field in the Group members dialog, above the search box: a short line the invited people read on their invitation.

members.inviteNotePlaceholder.text: Why you’re adding them, or what the group is for
members.inviteNotePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the optional note field in the Group members dialog.

members.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the people search field in the "Group members" dialog.

members.add.description: Action shown on a person in the search results of the "Group members" dialog: pressing the row selects them to be invited.

members.inviting.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog while the invitations are being sent.

members.inviteNone.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog while nobody is selected yet. A verb.

members.inviteCount_one.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog. "Invite" is a verb; {{count}} is how many selected people will be invited.

members.inviteCount_other.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog. "Invite" is a verb; {{count}} is how many selected people will be invited.

members.leaveGroup.description: Button at the foot of the "Group members" dialog: the person stops being a member of this group chat. "Leave" is a verb.

shareItem.type.app.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: an app.

shareItem.type.issue.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: a request, something a member asked to have changed in a project.

shareItem.type.proposal.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: a proposed change to a project's code. A noun.

shareItem.type.governance.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

shareItem.type.spec.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: one version of a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do.

shareItem.group.all.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows every app.

shareItem.group.mine.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows only the projects the person builds.

shareItem.group.others.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows only projects built by other people.

shareItem.loadingApps.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog while the list loads.

shareItem.noSearchMatch.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog when the search finds none.

shareItem.noApps.text: No apps to share from yet.
shareItem.noApps.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog when the person has no apps to pick an item from.

shareItem.selected.description: Marker on the chosen app in the list of the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.loadFailed.description: Error in the "Share item" dialog when the list of apps could not be fetched.

shareItem.title.description: Title of the dialog for attaching an app, request or change from Homeroom to a message. "Share" is a verb.

shareItem.subtitle.text: Access is checked separately for every recipient.
shareItem.subtitle.description: Line under the "Share item" title: each person who receives the message sees the item only if they are allowed to.

shareItem.searchApps.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search field in the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.itemType.description: Legend of the group of chips in the "Share item" dialog that choose what kind of thing to attach.

shareItem.appLegend.description: Legend of the list in the "Share item" dialog where the app the item belongs to is chosen.

shareItem.filterApps.description: Accessible name of the chips that filter the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog. "Filter" is a verb.

shareItem.appsList.description: Accessible name of the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.issueNumber.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number of the issue to attach.

shareItem.governanceId.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number identifying the governance proposal to attach.

shareItem.proposalId.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number identifying the code proposal, or the work session, to attach.

shareItem.specVersion.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the version number of the change's plan to attach.

shareItem.note.text: The server resolves the live title and state. If access is later removed, the card becomes metadata-free and unavailable.
shareItem.note.description: Explanation at the foot of the "Share item" dialog: the card in the message always shows the item's current title and status, and shows nothing about it to someone who loses access.

shareTo.item.app.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: an app.

shareTo.item.issue.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a request for a change to a project. A noun.

shareTo.item.issueNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.proposal.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposed change to a project. A noun.

shareTo.item.proposalNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog. "Proposal" is a noun, a proposed change; {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.governance.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

shareTo.item.governanceNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposal to change a project's rules. {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.spec.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do. "Plan" is a noun.

shareTo.item.specNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog: a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do. "Plan" is a noun. {{number}} is the number of the session it belongs to, keep the #.

shareTo.item.unknown.description: Kind of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog when its kind is not recognised. A noun.

shareTo.item.unknownNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog when its kind is not recognised. {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.detail.direct.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a one-to-one conversation with the person named above it.

shareTo.detail.everyone.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a public channel that every Homeroom member can read. Homeroom is the product's name.

shareTo.detail.group_one.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a group chat and how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

shareTo.detail.group_other.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a group chat and how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

shareTo.detail.discussion.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a project's discussion channel. {{channel}} is the channel's handle; keep the # before it. "Discussion" is a noun.

shareTo.error.cannotPost.text: You can’t post in the {{discussion}} discussion.
shareTo.error.cannotPost.description: Error in the "Share to…" dialog when the person is not allowed to write in the chosen project's discussion. "Post" is a verb. {{discussion}} is the project's name.

shareTo.error.tooFast.text: You’re sharing quickly. Wait a minute and try again.

shareTo.error.failed.description: Error in the "Share to…" dialog when sharing failed and the server gave no reason.

shareTo.sharedTo.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. {{destination}} is where it went: a person as @username, a group's name, a channel as #name or a project's name.

shareTo.sharedToUntitled.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. Used when it went to a conversation that has no name; "Conversation" is written as the toast has always shown it.

shareTo.sharedToUnknown.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. Used when it went to a person whose username is not known; "@unknown" is written as the toast has always shown it.

shareTo.title.description: Title of the dialog for sending an app, request or change to a conversation or a project's discussion. "Share" is a verb.

shareTo.sendTo.description: Label of the search field in the "Share to…" dialog; the list of destinations follows.

shareTo.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search field in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.listName.description: Accessible name of the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.loading.description: Shown in the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog while it loads.

shareTo.noMatch.description: Shown in the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog when the search finds none.

shareTo.empty.text: No chats or discussions to share to yet.

shareTo.selected.description: Marker on the chosen destination in the list of the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.noteLabel.description: Label of the text field in the "Share to…" dialog for a note sent along with the shared item.

shareTo.notePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the note field in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.discussionNote.text: Posts the link in the {{discussion}} discussion. Everyone there sees the card if they can open it.

shareTo.sharing.description: Label of the send button in the "Share to…" dialog while the item is being shared.

shareTo.send.description: Button in the "Share to…" dialog: shares the item to the chosen destination.

row.error.unread.description: Error under a message when marking the conversation unread from it failed and the server gave no reason.

row.block.message.text: Their messages in shared chats and app discussions will be hidden, and they won’t be able to message you directly.
row.block.message.description: Body of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message: what blocking does.

row.block.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message. A verb.

row.delete.message.text: Everyone will see “Message deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.

row.delete.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before deleting a message.

row.markedUnread.description: Brief confirmation after choosing "Mark unread" on a message.

row.menu.viewThread.description: Item in a message's actions menu when the message already has replies in a thread: opens the thread.

row.botThread.updates_one.description: Button under a request's card in the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread, where the bot posts each step and its news. {{count}} is how many messages the thread holds; English spells the singular with the number.

row.botThread.updates_other.description: Button under a request's card in the chat with Homeroom bot: opens the request's thread, where the bot posts each step and its news. {{count}} is how many messages the thread holds.
