row.botThread.inFirstVersion.description: Small label over a message from Homeroom bot shown in the main chat that was posted in the thread about a project's first version; tapping it opens that thread. {{project}} is the project's name, said twice: the thread's name, then the project.

row.botThread.inNumbered.description: Small label over a message from Homeroom bot shown in the main chat that was posted in a request's thread, when the request has no title; tapping it opens that thread. {{number}} is the request's number, keep the #; {{project}} is the project's name.

row.botThread.inProject.description: Small label over a message from Homeroom bot shown in the main chat that was posted in a request's thread, when the request has neither title nor number; tapping it opens that thread. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.menu.replyInThread.description: Item in a message's actions menu: opens a thread under the message to reply there.

row.menu.edit.description: Item in the actions menu of your own message: lets you change its text.

row.menu.copyText.description: Item in a message's actions menu: copies the message's words to the clipboard.

row.textCopied.description: Brief confirmation after copying a message's words to the clipboard.

row.menu.copyLink.description: Item in a message's actions menu: copies a link that opens the conversation at this message.

row.linkCopied.description: Brief confirmation after copying the link to a message.

row.menu.markUnread.description: Item in a message's actions menu: marks the conversation as unread from this message on.

row.menu.delete.description: Item in the actions menu of your own message: deletes it for everyone.

row.menu.report.description: Item in a message's actions menu: reports the message to Homeroom's moderators. "Report" is a verb.

row.reportLabel.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. {{name}} is the message's author as shown on it, a username with @.

row.reportLabelUnknownHandle.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.reportLabelUnknown.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.menu.block.description: Item in a message's actions menu: stops the message's author from messaging you and hides their messages. "Block" is a verb. {{name}} is the author as shown on the message, a username with @.

row.menu.blockUnknownHandle.description: Item in a message's actions menu: stops the message's author from messaging you and hides their messages. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in a message's actions menu: stops the message's author from messaging you and hides their messages. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.sheet.reply.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone: starts a reply to this message. A verb.

row.sheet.unsave.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone, for a message you saved: removes it from your saved messages.

row.sheet.save.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone: keeps this message in your saved messages, which are listed in the notifications panel.

row.deleted.description: Shown in a conversation in place of a message that its author deleted.

row.quote.deleted.description: Shown in the quote above a reply in place of the quoted message's words when that message was deleted.

row.quote.attachment.description: Shown in the quote above a reply in place of the quoted message's words when that message is only a file or picture. A noun.

row.editLabel.description: Accessible label of the text field that replaces your message while you edit it.

row.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside a message author's name when the author is an AI assistant rather than a person.

row.edited.description: Small note beside a message's time when the message was changed after it was sent. Lower case.

row.notSent.description: Red note under your message when sending it failed.

row.discard.description: Button under a message that failed to send: throws the unsent message away.

inbox.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside a name in the conversation list when the other party is an AI assistant rather than a person.

inbox.requestReview.description: Second line of a row in the conversation list for a direct conversation someone asked to start with you: tapping it lets you accept or decline. A "message request" is their first message, waiting for your answer.

inbox.invitationReview.description: Second line of a row in the conversation list for a group chat you were invited to: tapping it lets you accept or decline.

inbox.noMessages.description: Second line of a row in the conversation list for a conversation or channel in which nothing has been written.

inbox.unread_one.description: Accessible name of the number badge on a row of the conversation list: how many unread messages that conversation or channel has. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.unread_other.description: Accessible name of the number badge on a row of the conversation list: how many unread messages that conversation or channel has. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.memberCount_one.description: Spoken name and hover text of the people glyph and number on a group conversation's row in the conversation list: how many people are in the group. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.memberCount_other.description: Spoken name and hover text of the people glyph and number on a group conversation's row in the conversation list: how many people are in the group. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.newCount_one.description: At the end of a conversation's row in the Messages list, in grey: how many messages in it the person has not read yet. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.newCount_other.description: At the end of a conversation's row in the Messages list, in grey: how many messages in it the person has not read yet. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.previewBy.description: Second line of a channel's row in the conversation list: who wrote the latest message and its text. {{username}} is the author (keep the @) and {{message}} the message.

inbox.previewYou.description: Second line of a group chat's row in the conversation list when the signed-in person wrote the latest message. {{message}} is the message.

inbox.everyone.description: Second line of the #general channel's row in the conversation list while nothing has been written there: who the channel is for. Homeroom is the product's name.

inbox.new.agent.label.description: Choice in the "New message" menu: starts a new conversation with the coding agent, which can plan and build a change to any project.

inbox.new.agent.hint.text: Plan and build a change with a coding agent
inbox.new.agent.hint.description: Explains the "Agent chat" choice in the "New message" menu. "Change" is a noun: a change to a project.

inbox.new.direct.label.description: Choice in the "New message" menu: starts a one-to-one conversation.

inbox.new.direct.hint.description: Explains the "Direct message" choice in the "New message" menu.

inbox.new.group.label.description: Choice in the "New message" menu: creates a conversation with several people.

inbox.new.group.hint.description: Explains the "Group chat" choice in the "New message" menu.

inbox.new.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the + button above the conversation list: opens the menu of kinds of conversation to start.

inbox.new.menuName.description: Accessible name of the menu opened by the + button above the conversation list.

inbox.section.agents.description: Small-caps heading over the Messages list section that holds the viewer's conversations with AI agents and their changes in flight. It is a button that folds the section away and opens it again.

inbox.section.people.description: Small-caps heading over the last section of the Messages list, under Agents: the viewer's direct messages and group chats with people. It does not fold.

inbox.section.working_one.description: Beside the Agents heading in the Messages list, also while the section is folded: how many of the viewer's agent conversations are working right now. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.section.working_other.description: Beside the Agents heading in the Messages list, also while the section is folded: how many of the viewer's agent conversations are working right now. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.section.unread_one.description: Beside the People heading in the Messages list, in the accent colour, also while the section is folded: how many messages from people the viewer has not read. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.section.unread_other.description: Beside the People heading in the Messages list, in the accent colour, also while the section is folded: how many messages from people the viewer has not read. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.loading.description: Accessible label of the placeholder rows shown while the conversation list loads.

inbox.older.show_one.description: Quiet link at the foot of the Agents section in Messages: shows the agent chat nobody has used in the last seven days. {{count}} is how many there are.

inbox.older.show_other.description: Quiet link at the foot of the Agents section in Messages: shows the agent chats nobody has used in the last seven days. {{count}} is how many there are.

inbox.older.hide.description: Quiet link at the foot of the Agents section in Messages, once the older agent chats are shown: folds them away again.

inbox.archived.show.description: Button at the foot of the Agents list in Messages: opens the group of archived agent chats, which search does not cover.

inbox.archived.hide.description: Button at the foot of the Agents list in Messages, once the archived group is open: folds it away again.

inbox.archived.heading.description: Heading over the group of archived agent chats in the Agents list, shown while "Show archived" is open.

inbox.archived.empty.description: Shown in place of the archived group's rows in the Agents list when nothing has been archived yet.

inbox.listName.description: Accessible name of the pane that holds the conversation list.

inbox.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search field above the conversation list; it filters the list by name.

inbox.searchLabel.description: Accessible label of the search field above the conversation list.

inbox.offline.text: Offline. Queued messages retry when you reconnect.
inbox.offline.description: Banner above the conversation list while the device has no connection: messages written now are kept and sent later.

inbox.empty.title.description: Heading in place of the conversation list when the person has no conversations at all.

inbox.empty.body.text: Start a direct conversation or bring a group together.
inbox.empty.body.description: Text under "No messages yet" in place of an empty conversation list.

inbox.empty.action.description: Button under the empty conversation list: opens the dialog for starting a conversation.

inbox.searchEmpty.description: Shown in place of the conversation list when the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed.

invitation.error.respond.description: Error on the invitation banner when accepting or declining failed and the server gave no reason.

invitation.error.declineBlock.text: Couldn’t decline and block this requester.
invitation.error.declineBlock.description: Error on the invitation banner when declining and blocking the person who sent the request failed and the server gave no reason.

invitation.messageRequest.description: Heading of the banner at the top of a direct conversation someone asked to start with you. A "message request" is their first message, waiting for you to accept or decline.

invitation.groupInvitation.description: Heading of the banner at the top of a group chat you were invited to and have not joined yet.

invitation.invitedBy.text: @{{username}} invited you. Accepting gives you access to the complete retained conversation history.
invitation.invitedBy.description: Text of the invitation banner at the top of a conversation. {{username}} is who invited you; keep the @. "Retained" means the messages the conversation still keeps.

invitation.invitedByUnknown.text: @unknown invited you. Accepting gives you access to the complete retained conversation history.
invitation.invitedByUnknown.description: Text of the invitation banner at the top of a conversation. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

invitation.invitedBySomeone.text: Someone invited you. Accepting gives you access to the complete retained conversation history.
invitation.invitedBySomeone.description: Text of the invitation banner at the top of a conversation when it is not known who invited you. "Retained" means the messages the conversation still keeps.

invitation.decline.description: Button on the invitation banner: turns the message request or group invitation down.

invitation.declineAndBlock.description: Button on the invitation banner: turns the request down and also stops that person from messaging you again. "Block" is a verb. {{username}} is who sent the request; keep the @.

invitation.declineAndBlockUnknown.description: Button on the invitation banner: turns the request down and also stops that person from messaging you again. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

invitation.accept.description: Button on the invitation banner: accepts the message request or group invitation.

invitation.groupSummary_one.description: First line under the heading of a group invitation card: the group's name and how many people have already joined. {{title}} is the group's name; {{count}} is the number of members who accepted.

invitation.groupSummary_other.description: First line under the heading of a group invitation card: the group's name and how many people have already joined. {{title}} is the group's name; {{count}} is the number of members who accepted.

invitation.addedYouWithNote.description: Text of a group invitation card when the inviter wrote a note about why you were added. {{username}} is who added you; keep the @. {{note}} is their note.

invitation.addedYouWithNoteUnknown.description: Text of a group invitation card when the inviter's username is not known and they wrote a note. "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{note}} is the inviter's note.

invitation.addedYouWithNoteSomeone.description: Text of a group invitation card when it is not known who added you and they wrote a note. {{note}} is the inviter's note.

invitation.historyNotice.text: Accepting gives you access to the complete retained conversation history.
invitation.historyNotice.description: Second line under the "added you" line of a group invitation card that carries a note. "Retained" means the messages the conversation still keeps.

header.showList.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button in a conversation's header while the conversation fills the whole width: brings the conversation list back beside it.

header.fullWidth.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button in a conversation's header: hides the conversation list so the conversation fills the whole width.

header.block.title.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking the other person in a direct conversation. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. {{name}} is that person as shown in the header, a username with @.

header.block.titleUnknownHandle.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking the other person in a direct conversation. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.block.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking the other person in a direct conversation. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.block.message.text: Their messages in shared chats and app discussions will be hidden, and they won’t be able to message you directly.
header.block.message.description: Body of the confirmation before blocking the other person in a direct conversation: what blocking does.

header.block.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before blocking the other person in a direct conversation. A verb.

header.block.failed.description: Brief error after blocking the other person in a direct conversation failed and the server gave no reason.

header.rename.title.description: Title of the prompt for giving a group chat a new name.

header.rename.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the field in the "Rename group" prompt.

header.rename.failed.description: Brief error after renaming a group chat failed and the server gave no reason.

header.subtitle.channel_one.description: Line under the #general channel's name in its header: what the channel is and how many members it has. Homeroom is the product's name. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.channel_other.description: Line under the #general channel's name in its header: what the channel is and how many members it has. Homeroom is the product's name. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invited.description: Line under a conversation's name in its header while you have been invited and have not answered yet.

header.subtitle.group_one.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.group_other.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.groupOwner_one.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header, shown to its owner: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.groupOwner_other.description: Line under a group chat's name in its header, shown to its owner: how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invitedCount_one.description: Added after the member count under a group chat's name in its header ("2 members · 1 invited"): how many people were asked to join and have not answered yet. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.invitedCount_other.description: Added after the member count under a group chat's name in its header ("2 members · 3 invited"): how many people were asked to join and have not answered yet. {{count}} is that number.

header.subtitle.requestPending.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header while they have not accepted your message request yet. "Request" is a noun.

header.subtitle.direct.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header.

header.subtitle.homeroomBot.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of the chat with it: what the bot is for.

header.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside the name in a conversation's header when the other party is an AI assistant rather than a person.

header.groupMembers.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the people button in a group chat's header: opens the list of its members.

header.actions.description: Accessible name of the "…" button in a conversation's header and of the menu it opens.

header.menu.rename.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the prompt to change the group's name.

header.menu.members.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the dialog listing its members and pending invitations.

header.menu.block.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. {{name}} is that person as shown in the header, a username with @.

header.menu.blockUnnamedHandle.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnnamed.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu when the other person is not known; it is disabled. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

header.menu.report.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: reports the other person to Homeroom's moderators. "Report" is a verb.

header.menu.botFeedback.description: Item in the "…" menu of the conversation with Homeroom bot, where a person's conversation offers Block and Report: opens the dialog for sending feedback to Homeroom about the bot.

header.menu.refresh.description: Item in a conversation's "…" menu: reloads the conversation from the server.

thread.day.today.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent today.

thread.day.yesterday.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent yesterday.

discussion.error.title.text: This discussion could not be opened.
discussion.error.title.description: Heading shown in Messages in place of a project's discussion that failed to open.

discussion.error.body.text: It may have been removed, or you may not be a member of that app.
discussion.error.body.description: Text under "This discussion could not be opened." in Messages.

discussion.subtitle.archived.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its old discussion, which can be read but no longer written in.

discussion.subtitle.channel.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion channel. {{channel}} is the channel's handle; keep the # before it.

discussion.subtitle.everyone.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion when the channel has no handle: who the discussion is for.

agent.sessionName.description: Accessible name of the pane in Messages that shows a working session with a coding agent.

agent.row.prNumber.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list. "PR" is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

agent.row.changeId.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when nothing else names it. "Change" is a noun; {{id}} is its number.

agent.row.noChange.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when the session is not working on any change. "Change" is a noun.

agent.row.newSession.description: Name of a coding-agent session that has no title yet, on its row in the conversation list.

agent.row.activity.working.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent is working. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.activity.done.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent has finished its turn. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.working.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list while the agent is working.

agent.session.openFull.description: Link above a coding-agent session shown inside Messages: opens the same session on its own full page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.unavailable.text: This session could not be opened here.
agent.session.unavailable.description: Error in Messages in place of a coding-agent session that could not be shown inside the Messages screen.

agent.session.openInApp.description: Link under "This session could not be opened here.": opens the session on the project's own page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.loading.description: Shown in Messages while a coding-agent session loads.

thread.empty.title.description: Heading in the right-hand pane of Messages on a wide screen while no conversation is open.

thread.empty.body.text: Your chats open here. A community's channel is on its hub, under Communities.
thread.empty.body.description: Text under "Choose a conversation": conversations open in this pane, and a community's channel is found on that community's page in the Communities tab.

thread.showMoreCards_one.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.showMoreCards_other.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.paneName.description: Accessible name of the pane showing a conversation that has no title. A noun.

thread.loading.description: Shown in a conversation while its messages load.

thread.left.description: Shown in place of a group chat's messages after you left it.

thread.backToMessages.description: Button shown where a conversation can no longer be opened: returns to the conversation list. Messages is the screen's name.

thread.emptyConversation.description: Shown in a conversation in which nothing has been written, under a waving hand.

thread.loadingOlder.description: Line at the top of a conversation while earlier messages load after scrolling up.

thread.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a conversation, shown only after loading earlier messages failed: tries again.

thread.loadingNewer.description: Label of the "Load newer messages" button while newer messages load.

thread.loadNewer.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: fetches the messages after the ones shown.

thread.jumpToPresent.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: goes straight to the newest messages.

thread.typingOne.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. {{name}} is that person's name.

thread.typingOneUnknown.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. Used when the person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwo.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. {{first}} and {{second}} are the names of two of them.

thread.typingTwoUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the usernames of both people typing are not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwoFirstUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the first person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{second}} is the other person's name.

thread.typingTwoSecondUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the second person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{first}} is the other person's name.

thread.botWorking.thinking.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot is working on an answer and has not said what it is doing. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.progress.text: Checking how your work is going
thread.botWorking.progress.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot reads how the reader's requests are going. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.request.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot reads one request. {{number}} is the request's number. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.code.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot reads a project's code. {{project}} is the project's name. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.codeUnnamed.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot reads a project's code, when the project's name is not known. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.drawing.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot draws a design of a screen. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.designing.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot changes a design it drew. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.drafting.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot drafts a request for the reader to file. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.looking.description: On the card at the end of the chat while a helper of Homeroom bot reads a project's code to answer the reader, which can take a few minutes. {{project}} is the project's name. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.botWorking.lookingUnnamed.description: On the card at the end of the chat while a helper of Homeroom bot reads a project's code, when the project's name is not known. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

botCards.investigation.label.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: its small label, shown in capitals. {{day}} is which day of the investigation it is, {{days}} the most days it may run.

botCards.investigation.labelProposed_one.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: its small label before it is started, shown in capitals, when it may run for one day.

botCards.investigation.labelProposed_oth.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: its small label before it is started, shown in capitals. {{count}} is the most days it may run.

botCards.investigation.labelDeclined.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: its small label once the reader chose not to start it, shown in capitals.

botCards.investigation.cadence_one.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again.

botCards.investigation.cadence_other.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again. {{count}} is a number of hours.

botCards.investigation.cadenceModel_one.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again, and the AI model that does it. {{model}} is the model's name, for example DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

botCards.investigation.cadenceModel_othe.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again, and the AI model that does it. {{count}} is a number of hours; {{model}} is the model's name, for example DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

botCards.investigation.cadenceProject_on.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again. {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.investigation.cadenceProject_ot.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is a number of hours.

botCards.investigation.cadenceProjectMod.text: Checks in on {{project}} every hour, on {{model}}
botCards.investigation.cadenceProjectMod.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again, and the AI model that does it. {{project}} is the project's name; {{model}} is the model's name, for example DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

botCards.investigation.cadenceProjectMod.text: Checks in on {{project}} every {{count}} hours, on {{model}}
botCards.investigation.cadenceProjectMod.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how often it looks at the project again, and the AI model that does it. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is a number of hours; {{model}} is the model's name, for example DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

botCards.investigation.spent.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: how much of its own budget it has used so far, over a thin bar. {{spent}} and {{budget}} are amounts of money, for example $0.38 and $3.00.

botCards.investigation.budget.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: its own budget, before it has spent anything. {{budget}} is an amount of money, for example $3.00.

botCards.investigation.next.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: when it looks at the project again. {{time}} is a time of day, with the day of the week when it is not today.

botCards.investigation.checkingNow.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: it is looking at the project right now.

botCards.investigation.timeline.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: the name, for screen readers, of the list of its last three check-ins, each a time and one line of what it found.

botCards.investigation.declined.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: the reader chose Not now, so it never ran.

botCards.investigation.ended.answered.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.budget.text: Ended: it used all of its budget
botCards.investigation.ended.budget.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.days.text: Ended: it ran for all of its days
botCards.investigation.ended.days.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.stopped.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: the reader stopped it.

botCards.investigation.ended.botOff.text: Ended: Homeroom bot was turned off
botCards.investigation.ended.botOff.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.paused.text: Ended: Homeroom bot stopped working on this project
botCards.investigation.ended.paused.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.gone.text: Ended: you can no longer build on this project
botCards.investigation.ended.gone.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.failed.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: why it ended.

botCards.investigation.ended.other.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: it ended, for a reason this screen does not know.

botCards.investigation.choices.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: the name, for screen readers, of its row of buttons.

botCards.investigation.start.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that starts it. Nothing runs or costs anything until it is pressed.

botCards.investigation.notNow.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that sets it aside without starting it.

botCards.investigation.stop.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that ends it now.

botCards.investigation.notes.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that opens, on the card, everything it has found so far.

botCards.investigation.hideNotes.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that closes its notes again.

botCards.investigation.file.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: button that asks Homeroom bot to draft requests from what it found.

botCards.investigation.fileWords.description: Sent as the reader's own message to Homeroom bot when they press "File what it found" on an investigation's card; the bot then drafts requests from what it found.

botCards.investigation.failed.text: That did not work. Try again.
botCards.investigation.failed.description: On the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply about an investigation it runs on one of the reader's projects over several days: shown when a press of one of its buttons did not go through.

thread.botWorking.writing.description: On the card at the end of the chat while Homeroom bot writes its answer; the answer so far is shown under it as it grows. Three animated dots follow it, as an ellipsis.

thread.activityTimeRange.description: Time shown on the card of replies made in a thread when they span more than one minute: the time of the first reply and of the last. {{start}} and {{end}} are clock times.

replies.paneName.description: Accessible name of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

replies.title.description: Title at the top of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

design.pane.label.description: Accessible name of the pane beside a design thread that draws the design's current version.

design.pane.loading.description: Shown in the design pane while the design or one of its versions is loading.

design.pane.failed.text: The design couldn't be drawn just now.
design.pane.failed.description: Shown in the design pane when the design or a version of it could not be read.

design.pane.pickVersion.description: Screen-reader label of the picker that chooses which version of the design the preview draws.

design.pane.versionOption.description: One choice in the design pane's version picker, for a version with no note.

design.pane.versionNote.description: One choice in the design pane's version picker: the version number, then what the bot said it changed.

design.pane.ofTotal.description: After the version picker in the design pane: how many versions there are, as in "Version 3 of 5".

design.pane.comment.description: Button in the design pane that turns on pinning a comment on the preview.

design.pane.commentDone.description: The same button while pinning is on: turns it off.

design.pane.commentHint.text: Click the preview where you want a change, then say what.
design.pane.commentHint.description: Hint under the design pane's header while pinning a comment is on.

design.pane.pinOn.description: Above the box for a pinned comment's words: the element the pin is on, in a few words taken from it.

design.pane.pinPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box for a comment pinned on the design.

design.pane.pinSend.description: Sends the pinned comment to Homeroom bot in the design thread.

design.pane.pinCancel.description: Drops the pin being placed and its words.

design.pane.propose.description: Button in the design pane that opens the card for filing the design as a public request.

design.pane.proposed.description: Link in the design pane once the design was filed: opens the request it became.

design.pane.frameTitle.description: Accessible title of the frame that draws one version of the design.

design.pane.showChat.description: On a phone: switches from the design's preview to its thread.

design.pane.back.description: On a phone, the arrow at the top left of a design's preview, which covers the screen: goes back to the private thread the design is in. Its accessible name and tooltip.

design.pane.close.description: The × at the right of a design's preview, the column beside a private thread on the Homeroom bot tab: closes the preview. Its accessible name and tooltip.

design.card.open.description: Button under the small picture of a design's version, in a private thread with Homeroom bot: opens the design's preview beside the thread, at that version.

design.card.openVersion.description: Accessible name of the small picture of a design's version in a private thread with Homeroom bot, which opens the preview as the Open preview button does. {{version}} is the version's number.

design.card.label.description: The line beside Open preview under the small picture of a design's version in a private thread: the screen's name and the version's number.

design.card.frameTitle.description: Title of the frame that draws a design's version small in a private thread with Homeroom bot (read by assistive technology). {{version}} is the version's number.

design.card.failed.text: This version couldn't be drawn just now.
design.card.failed.description: In place of the small picture of a design's version in a private thread, when it could not be read.

newThread.start.description: The "+" button in the Homeroom bot tab's header and in the header of the chat with Homeroom bot in Messages: starts a new blank thread with the bot. Its accessible name and tooltip.

newThread.title.description: Title of the blank thread pane the "+" opens, before anything is sent in it.

newThread.sub.text: With Homeroom bot, only you can see it
newThread.sub.description: Line under the title of the blank thread pane: the thread is private to the person.

newThread.close.description: Closes the blank thread pane without starting anything.

newThread.project.description: Label of the menu in a new thread that chooses the project the change is for.

newThread.anyProject.description: The project menu's first choice and default in a new thread: the change is not tied to one project yet.

newThread.kind.description: Label of the menu in a new thread that chooses what kind of change to make.

newThread.kinds.any.description: The change menu's first choice and default in a new thread.

newThread.kinds.fix.description: A choice in the change menu of a new thread with Homeroom bot.

newThread.kinds.add.description: A choice in the change menu of a new thread with Homeroom bot.

newThread.kinds.design.description: A choice in the change menu of a new thread with Homeroom bot: work on how a screen looks, in a design thread with a live preview.

newThread.draws.text: Describe the screen and Homeroom bot draws it.
newThread.draws.description: In a new thread with Homeroom bot, under the kind of change once "Design a screen" is picked: the person says what the screen should be in the message box, and the bot draws it in the thread.

newThread.hint.text: Start a change here, or just type what you want into the chat.
newThread.hint.description: Small text at the end of the welcome block of a new thread with Homeroom bot.

newThread.placeholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the message box in a new blank thread.

newThread.send.description: Sends the first message of a new thread, which starts it.

newThread.failed.text: The thread couldn't be started just now. Try again in a minute.
newThread.failed.description: Shown in a new thread when starting it failed for a reason that was not said.

design.pane.showPreview.description: On a phone, in a design thread's header: switches from the thread to the design's preview.

design.propose.heading.description: Heading of the card that files the design as a request.

design.propose.warning.text: This files a public request on {{project}} under your name. Its plan shows the first version and version {{version}} side by side, and anyone who can see the project can see them. Check they show nothing private, such as names, messages or numbers. This thread stays private.
design.propose.warning.description: Warning in the Propose it card, before anything is filed: what becomes public.

design.propose.defaultTitle.description: The request's title the Propose it card starts with: the screen's name after "Design:".

design.propose.titleLabel.description: Label of the request title field in the Propose it card.

design.propose.notesLabel.description: Label of the notes field in the Propose it card; the notes become the request's description.

design.propose.send.description: Submit button of the Propose it card.

design.propose.cancel.description: Closes the Propose it card without filing.

design.propose.failed.text: It couldn't be filed just now. Try again in a minute.
design.propose.failed.description: Shown in the Propose it card when filing failed for a reason that was not said.

design.propose.headingOn.text: Post this design as a plan
design.propose.headingOn.description: Heading of the design pane's Propose it card when the design's thread is about a request (a filed issue): it posts the design on that request as the person's plan.

design.propose.warningOn.text: This posts version {{version}} as your plan on request #{{number}} on {{project}}, under your name, where anyone who can see the project can see it. Check it shows nothing private, such as names, messages or numbers. This thread stays private.
design.propose.warningOn.description: Warning in the design pane's Propose it card when the thread is about a request (a filed issue), before anything is posted: what becomes public.

design.propose.sendOn.description: Submit button of the design pane's Propose it card when the thread is about a request: posts the design on it as the person's plan.

design.pane.postedOn.text: Posted as a plan on request #{{number}}
design.pane.postedOn.description: Link in the design pane once the design was posted as a plan on a request (a filed issue): opens that request. The design can be posted again as the plan's next version.

botCards.gallery.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the grid of pictures under a Homeroom bot reply, made on an outside picture model.

botCards.gallery.open.description: Accessible name of one picture in the bot's picture grid: tapping it opens the picture full screen. {{label}} is its letter, and light or dark.

botCards.gallery.captionLight.description: Caption under a picture in the bot's picture grid when it comes in a light and a dark version: this is the light one. {{letter}} is A to D.

botCards.gallery.captionDark.description: Caption under a picture in the bot's picture grid when it comes in a light and a dark version: this is the dark one. {{letter}} is A to D.

botCards.gallery.pickGroup.description: Accessible name of the row of letters (A, B, C, D) under the bot's picture grid that chooses which picture the buttons below act on.

botCards.gallery.pick.description: Accessible name of one letter button under the bot's picture grid: chooses picture {{letter}} for the buttons below.

botCards.gallery.actions.description: Accessible name of the row of buttons under the bot's picture grid (propose it, use it, more like it).

botCards.gallery.feature.description: Button under the bot's picture grid, for a person who may change the project's card picture: opens a vote in the project's group on picture {{letter}} as the picture on its card in Discover.

botCards.gallery.featured.description: Shown in place of the propose button once picture {{letter}} was proposed as the project's card picture: the group votes on it.

botCards.gallery.seeVote.description: Link under the bot's picture grid once a picture was proposed as the project's card picture: opens that vote.

botCards.gallery.use.description: Button under the bot's picture grid: asks Homeroom bot to put picture {{letter}} in the project's app (it offers a request carrying the picture).

botCards.gallery.used.text: Asked to use {{letter}} in the app
botCards.gallery.used.description: The use button once tapped, grey with a check: the person asked the bot to use picture {{letter}} in the app.

botCards.gallery.design.description: Button under the bot's picture grid in a design thread: adds picture {{letter}} to the design, for its next version.

botCards.gallery.designed.description: The add-to-design button once tapped, grey with a check: picture {{letter}} was added to the design thread's pictures.

botCards.gallery.more.description: Button under the bot's picture grid: asks Homeroom bot for more pictures like picture {{letter}}.

botCards.gallery.useWords.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message when they tap Use it in the app under its pictures. {{project}} is the project's name and {{url}} the picture's link, which the request it offers carries.

botCards.gallery.useWordsNoProject.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message when they tap Use it in the app under pictures made for no project yet. {{url}} is the picture's link.

botCards.gallery.designWords.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message in a design thread when they tap Add to the design under its pictures.

botCards.gallery.moreWords.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message when they tap More like under its pictures.

botCards.gallery.paid.text: Paid from your weekly building time.
botCards.gallery.paid.description: Quiet line under the pictures Homeroom bot made: they counted toward the person's own weekly building time with the bot.

botCards.gallery.failed.text: That didn't work just now. Try again in a minute.
botCards.gallery.failed.description: Shown under the bot's picture grid when a tap on one of its buttons failed and the server said nothing more.

botCards.compare.heading.description: Small label over the card that shows versions of a design side by side, under Homeroom bot's reply in a design thread.

botCards.compare.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of small previews in the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.sizeGroup.description: Accessible name of the Phone and Desktop switch on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.phone.description: Switch on the card that compares versions of a design: draws each version at a phone's width.

botCards.compare.desktop.description: Switch on the card that compares versions of a design: draws each version at a desktop's width.

botCards.compare.now.description: Label of the screen as it is today, beside its new versions, on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.version.description: Label of one version on the card that compares versions of a design, when the bot gave it no name of its own.

botCards.compare.frameTitle.description: Title of the small preview of one version on the card that compares versions of a design. {{label}} is the version's name.

botCards.compare.open.description: Accessible name of a small preview on the card that compares versions of a design: opens that version in the design preview.

botCards.compare.pick.description: Button under one version on the card that compares versions of a design: picks it, and tells Homeroom bot.

botCards.compare.pickLabel.description: Accessible name of the Pick button under one version on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.picked.description: The Pick button once tapped, grey with a check, under the version picked on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.pickedLabel.description: Accessible name of the Picked button under the version picked on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.pickWords.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message when they pick a version on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.keepNowWords.text: Keep it as it is now
botCards.compare.keepNowWords.description: Words sent to Homeroom bot as the person's own message when they pick the screen as it is today on the card that compares versions of a design.

botCards.compare.propose.description: Button on the card that compares versions of a design, once a version was picked: opens the design's Propose it card for that version.

botCards.compare.failed.text: That didn't work just now. Try again in a minute.
botCards.compare.failed.description: Shown on the card that compares versions of a design when picking a version failed and the server said nothing more.

replies.close.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the X button on the thread side pane: closes the thread and returns to the conversation.

replies.resize.description: Accessible name of the divider between a chat and its open thread on a computer, which is dragged left and right to make the thread narrower or wider.

replies.count_one.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.count_other.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.loading.description: Shown in the thread side pane while the replies load.

replies.none.description: Shown in the thread side pane under the first message when nobody has replied.

replies.loadingEarlier.description: Label of the "Load earlier replies" button while earlier replies load.

replies.loadEarlier.description: Button in the thread side pane: fetches the replies before the ones shown.

replies.discussion.from.description: Line under the name of a message from a request's public discussion, shown inside that request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot: tapping it opens the request page, where the message can be replied to. Used once on each such message.

replies.discussion.more.text: Earlier messages are on the request's discussion
replies.discussion.more.description: Link at the top of a request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot: the request's public discussion has more messages than the newest ones shown here, and opening it shows them all.

replies.app.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the message box in a thread under a message of a project's channel.

replies.app.membersOnly.text: Only members of this app can reply here.
replies.app.membersOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box in a thread of a project's channel, shown to someone who is not a member of that project.

row.botBlock.requestLabel.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the request's title.

row.botBlock.requestLabelUntitled.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it, when the request's title is not known: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.ready.line.release.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when the change goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)"; this entry adds only the full stop that ends it.

bot.ready.change.request.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one: which request the change is for, then what it is. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the change's own title, else the request's.

bot.ready.change.requestUntitled.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one, when there is no title to say beside the number: which request the change is for. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.outcome.goingLiveRelease.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history, for a change to Homeroom itself: the change is built and merged, and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when it goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.plan.complicatedNote.text: Its before and after screens are on the request below. What you ask to change is posted there, where the group can see it.
bot.plan.complicatedNote.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits: its before and after screens are on the request card below, and what the reader asks to change is posted there for the community to see.

bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.text: What you ask to change is posted on the request below, where the group can see it.
bot.plan.complicatedNoteShown.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits and the card itself shows the plan and its before and after screens: what the reader asks to change is posted on the request card below, for the community to see.

bot.plan.spec.see.description: Row on Homeroom bot's plan card for a complicated change: opens the whole plan (what will change and its before and after screens) inside the card. "See" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.hide.description: The same row on Homeroom bot's plan card once the whole plan is open: folds the plan away again. "Hide" is a verb.

bot.plan.spec.sections.description: Accessible name of the two tabs over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card.

bot.plan.spec.tab.user.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says what people will see and do differently. Shown first.

bot.plan.spec.tab.tech.description: Tab over the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card: the half of the plan that says how it will be built, for developers.

bot.plan.spec.tabEmpty.description: Shown in a tab of the whole plan opened on Homeroom bot's plan card when that half of the plan is empty.

bot.track.state.queued.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: waiting for the bot to start on it.

bot.track.state.planning.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot is reading the request or writing its plan.

bot.track.state.waiting.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot needs something from the person reading: an answer, a go-ahead, more detail or a look.

bot.track.state.waitingNamed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot needs something from the person who asked for it (an answer, a go-ahead, more detail), shown to somebody else, on a page anyone can open. {{username}} is that person's username, after an @.

bot.track.state.building.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot is building the change.

bot.track.state.checks.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change's automated checks are running or have just run.

bot.track.state.vote.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change is waiting for the group's approval.

bot.track.state.going_live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change was approved and is being made live.

bot.track.state.live.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the change is live.

bot.track.state.held.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the request is ready but held back by a limit.

bot.track.state.stopped.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the bot stopped working on it.

bot.track.state.done_elsewhere.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: somebody else's change shipped what the request asked for.

bot.track.state.closed.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Short status word for a request whose state is: the request was closed.

bot.track.step.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. bot.track.bar.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. bot.track.barNone.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page.
