bot.track.tryDivider.description: Divider in a request's thread in the chat with Homeroom bot, before the messages of one of its tries, when the bot built it more than once. {{number}} is which try and {{date}} when it began.

bot.track.pictures.plan.text: The plan's screens, before and after
bot.track.pictures.plan.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Caption over the before and after pictures the bot drew in its plan for the change.

bot.track.pictures.change.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Caption over the before and after screenshots of the change the bot built.

bot.track.pictures.before.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label on the "before" picture of a change.

bot.track.pictures.after.description: The track of a request Homeroom bot works on: where the request is, drawn the same in the chat with the bot, a request's thread, the request's page and the bot's slots page. Label on the "after" picture of a change.

drawer.peek.open.description: On a phone, what a screen reader says for the last conversation, peeking in beside the list of conversations; pressing it opens that conversation. {{name}} is the conversation's name: a person's name or a group's title.

privateThread.label.text: Only you can see this thread.
privateThread.label.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): nothing in it is public until they file it or post it.

privateThread.newProject.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Button: asks who a project made from the thread's idea would be for.

privateThread.whoFor.text: It isn't in a community yet. Who is it for?
privateThread.whoFor.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Shown after New project, over three choices that each open Create with the thread's words.

privateThread.forMe.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a project only the person is in.

privateThread.forGroup.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a private project for people the person invites.

privateThread.forCommunity.description: The head of a private thread in the person's chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab): only they can see it until they file it, post it, or start a project from it. Choice under "Who is it for?": a public project anyone can join.

privateThread.filed.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) once it was filed. {{number}} is the new request's number, {{project}} the project's name.

privateThread.posted.description: Line at the top of a thread the person started in their private chat with Homeroom bot (the AI tab) once it was posted in an existing thread. {{number}} is the request's or change's number, {{project}} the project's name.

privateThread.open.description: Link after the filed or posted line at the top of a private thread with Homeroom bot: opens the request or change.

ai.hero.name.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Its heading, the bot's name, beside its picture.

ai.hero.both.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Line under the heading: {{needs}} is how many things in its Needs you list ask something of the person (a vote, an answer, a Build it), {{next}} how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.hero.next.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Line under the heading when nothing waits on the person: {{next}} is how many of their pieces of work are being worked on.

ai.work.title.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Label over the first list: what waits on the person (a vote, an answer, a plan to say Build it to) in the threads they are in, then their private threads.

ai.work.titleCount_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Label over the first list when something in it asks for the person: {{count}} is how many of its rows do (a vote, an answer, a Build it). It is a count, not a link.

ai.work.titleCount_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Label over the first list when something in it asks for the person: {{count}} is how many of its rows do (a vote, an answer, a Build it). It is a count, not a link.

ai.work.empty.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Shown in the Needs you list when it is empty.

ai.work.showMore_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Row at the end of a list showing only its first rows: shows the rest. {{count}} is how many more.

ai.work.showMore_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Row at the end of a list showing only its first rows: shows the rest. {{count}} is how many more.

ai.work.showLess.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Row at the end of a list showing all its rows: shows only the first ones again.

ai.row.where.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) that needs the person: the project and the request or change number.

ai.row.decide.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Homeroom bot says a person needs to decide
ai.row.decide.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of a request of the person's that Homeroom bot read and handed back, because a person has to decide something before it can be built.

ai.row.buildStopped.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of a request of the person's whose build by Homeroom bot came to nothing, so nothing happens until somebody asks it to try again.

ai.row.voteFreesSlot.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Your vote helps free a build slot
ai.row.voteFreesSlot.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: tooltip of the row of a vote on one of Homeroom bot's changes while a request of the person's waits for one of its slots on that project; deciding the change frees one.

ai.row.project.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) that needs the person and has no number: the project's name.

ai.row.privateDraft.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with a draft for a project: only the person can see it, which project it is for, and that it is not posted.

ai.row.privateIdea.text: Only you · Not in a community yet
ai.row.privateIdea.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a private thread's row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with an idea that is for no project yet: only the person can see it.

ai.row.privateAbout.description: Tooltip (and phone second line) of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's Needs you list for a private thread opened from a request's page: only the person sees it, the project, and the request it is about.

ai.row.privateAboutChange.description: Tooltip (and phone second line) of a row in the Homeroom bot tab's Needs you list for a private thread opened from a change's page: only the person sees it, the project, and the change it is about.

ai.pill.vote.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Pill at the end of a row: the person owes a vote on it.

ai.pill.pick.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Pill at the end of a row: the person owes a pick between competing changes.

ai.pill.answer.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Pill at the end of a row: Homeroom bot asked the person a question about it.

ai.pill.buildIt.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Pill at the end of a row: a plan waits for the person to say Build it.

ai.pill.decide.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request Homeroom bot handed back because a person has to decide something first. Opens the request.

ai.pill.tryAgain.description: The AI tab's main view, Needs you: the pill on a request whose build by Homeroom bot stopped. Opens the request, where Homeroom bot can be asked to build it again.

ai.pill.needsYou.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Pill at the end of a row that waits on the person, when it says no more than that.

ai.next.titleCount_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the label over the person's work being worked on, with how many.

ai.next.titleCount_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the label over the person's work being worked on, with how many.

ai.next.goingLive.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change was approved and is being put live.

ai.next.merging.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change was approved and is being merged.

ai.next.fixing.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Homeroom bot is fixing what its tests found
ai.next.fixing.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): one of its change's tests failed, and Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot (a name), is fixing it now.

ai.next.revising.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Homeroom bot is following up on the replies
ai.next.revising.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot (a name), is changing its change after the newest replies on it.

ai.next.reading.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot (a name), is reading the request to decide whether to ask a question or build it. "it" is the request.

ai.next.building.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): somebody other than the person and Homeroom bot is building a change for it.

ai.next.botBuilding.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot, the platform's builder bot (a name), is building a change for it. "it" is the request or thread the row is.

ai.next.youBuilding.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of an In progress row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): the person themself is building a change for it. "it" is the request or thread the row is.

ai.next.claimed.description: The AI tab's main view, In progress: tooltip of the row of a request of the person's that someone has claimed to build and has no change for yet. {{username}} is who claimed it.

ai.up.titleCount_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the label over the person's work with nothing for them to do on it, with how many.

ai.up.titleCount_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the label over the person's work with nothing for them to do on it, with how many.

ai.up.vote.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change is up for a vote and waits for other people's votes; the person's own does not need giving (a change they made on Homeroom counts as their yes).

ai.up.checking.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change is up for a vote, but its checks have not passed yet, so the checks are what it waits on.

ai.up.voteYes.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Waiting for votes · you voted Yes
ai.up.voteYes.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change is up for a vote, the person voted Yes on it, and it waits for other people's votes. "Yes" is the vote button's label; keep it the same as the button.

ai.up.voteNo.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Waiting for votes · you voted No
ai.up.voteNo.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): its change is up for a vote, the person voted No on it, and it waits for other people's votes. "No" is the vote button's label; keep it the same as the button.

ai.up.decision.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with no number: a group decision the person put up (a new name, a new card picture, …) that has nothing to build and waits for other people's votes. {{project}} is the project's name.

ai.up.decisionYes.text: {{project}} · Waiting for votes · you voted Yes
ai.up.decisionYes.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with no number: a group decision (a new name, a new card picture, …) the person voted Yes on, waiting for other people's votes. {{project}} is the project's name. "Yes" is the vote button's label; keep it the same as the button.

ai.up.decisionNo.text: {{project}} · Waiting for votes · you voted No
ai.up.decisionNo.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with no number: a group decision (a new name, a new card picture, …) the person voted No on, waiting for other people's votes. {{project}} is the project's name. "No" is the vote button's label; keep it the same as the button.

ai.up.fixQueued.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · A test failed · waiting for a free builder to fix it
ai.up.fixQueued.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): one of its change's tests failed, and Homeroom bot will fix it when one of its builders is free.

ai.up.followUpQueued.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Waiting for a free builder to follow up on the replies
ai.up.followUpQueued.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot will change its change after the newest replies when one of its builders is free.

ai.up.buildQueued.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · waiting its turn
ai.up.buildQueued.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot read the request and will build it; it waits for its turn, behind the project's other builds.

ai.up.held.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · waits until a change up for a vote is decided
ai.up.held.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot read the request and will build it, but only so many of a project's changes may wait for a vote at once, so it starts once one of them goes live or is closed.

ai.up.heldDaily.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · held by today's limit on this project
ai.up.heldDaily.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot read the request and will build it, but the project's daily limit on Homeroom bot's questions and notes is used up.

ai.up.heldYours_one.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · a vote you owe can free its slot
ai.up.heldYours_one.description: The AI tab's main view, Waiting: a request of the person's that Homeroom bot is ready to build, held because its changes up for a vote fill the project's slots, one of which waits on the person's vote (in Needs you).

ai.up.heldYours_other.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · {{count}} votes you owe can free its slot
ai.up.heldYours_other.description: The AI tab's main view, Waiting: a request of the person's that Homeroom bot is ready to build, held because its changes up for a vote fill the project's slots, several of which wait on the person's vote (in Needs you).

ai.up.stalled.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Ready to build · its build has not started
ai.up.stalled.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): Homeroom bot found the request ready to build, but nothing about the build has been recorded since.

ai.up.queued.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): the request is in Homeroom bot's queue, waiting for one of its builders to read it.

ai.up.onHold.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): the request waits in Homeroom bot's queue until the week resets, because this week's building time for it is used up.

ai.up.notPickedUp.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): a request in a thread the person is in that nobody has started a change for, and that Homeroom bot is not working on.

ai.up.awaitingPlan.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): their own request, which Homeroom bot does not build while they work on it with it in a private thread, until they post a plan or let it go ahead.

ai.up.notPickedUpBare.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too) with no number (a decision): nobody has started a change for it. {{project}} is the project's name.

ai.up.quiet_one.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Nobody is building it yet · quiet {{count}} day
ai.up.quiet_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): a request nobody has started a change for and nobody has written on lately. {{count}} is how many days.

ai.up.quiet_other.text: {{project}} · #{{number}} · Nobody is building it yet · quiet {{count}} days
ai.up.quiet_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a Waiting row (its whole line; read by a screen reader too): a request nobody has started a change for and nobody has written on lately. {{count}} is how many days.

ai.live.title_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Folding label over the person's work that went live in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

ai.live.title_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Folding label over the person's work that went live in the last week. {{count}} is how many.

ai.live.row.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. Tooltip of a one-line row in Live this week: its project and number.

ai.drawer.back.description: The AI tab on a phone: the back arrow over what is open beside the list (Main Chat, the chat with Homeroom bot, or one of its threads), which slides the list back in. Its accessible name and tooltip.

ai.drawer.peek.description: The AI tab on a phone: accessible name of the open thread peeking in beside the list, which opens it. {{title}} is the thread's name.

ai.filter.label.description: The AI tab's main view: accessible name of the row of project chips over the lists, which narrows them to the projects picked; also the title of the More projects panel those chips end with (a sheet on a phone).

ai.filter.all.description: The AI tab's main view: the first chip over the lists, showing every project's work. Pressed when no project chip is.

ai.filter.more_one.description: The AI tab's main view: the last chip over the lists, after the three projects that need the person most; opens the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many projects have no chip of their own.

ai.filter.more_other.description: The AI tab's main view: the last chip over the lists, after the three projects that need the person most; opens the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many projects have no chip of their own.

ai.filter.search.description: The AI tab's main view: placeholder and accessible name of the search box at the top of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; filters the projects by name.

ai.filter.group.needs.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects with something waiting on the person.

ai.filter.group.busy.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects with work under way or waiting on someone else, and nothing waiting on the person.

ai.filter.group.quiet.description: The AI tab's main view: small caps heading in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, over the projects that only had work go live this week.

ai.filter.note.needs_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, in the accent. {{count}} is how many things in it wait on the person.

ai.filter.note.needs_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show, in the accent. {{count}} is how many things in it wait on the person.

ai.filter.note.progress_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it are being worked on.

ai.filter.note.progress_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it are being worked on.

ai.filter.note.waiting_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it wait on someone else (votes, a free builder, the clock).

ai.filter.note.waiting_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it wait on someone else (votes, a free builder, the clock).

ai.filter.note.live_one.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it went live in the last week.

ai.filter.note.live_other.description: The AI tab's main view: right of a project in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show. {{count}} is how many of the person's requests in it went live in the last week.

ai.filter.none.description: The AI tab's main view: in the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show when its search matches no project. {{query}} is what the person typed.

ai.filter.showAll.description: The AI tab's main view: link at the foot of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; unpicks every project so the lists show all of them again.

ai.filter.done.description: The AI tab's main view: button at the foot of the More projects panel (a menu under the last chip from 768px, a sheet on a phone), which lists every project in the lists to pick the ones whose work they show; closes it. Picks apply as they are made.

ai.live.number.description: The AI tab's main view, Live this week: the number at the end of a one-line row for a change that went live this week.

ai.short.goingLive.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: its change is going live.

ai.short.merging.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: its change is being merged.

ai.short.fixing.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: Homeroom bot is fixing what its tests found.

ai.short.revising.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: Homeroom bot is following up on replies to its change.

ai.short.reading.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: Homeroom bot is reading the request.

ai.short.bot.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: who is building it, Homeroom bot.

ai.short.you.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: who is building it, the person themselves.

ai.short.claimed.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: who claimed it and is building it, by username.

ai.short.building.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in In progress: somebody is building it.

ai.short.votes.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: it waits for the group's votes.

ai.short.checks.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: it waits for its checks to pass before the vote can merge it.

ai.short.builder.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: it waits for a free builder in Homeroom bot's queue.

ai.short.turn.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: ready to build, waiting its turn among the project's builds.

ai.short.slot.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: ready to build, waiting for one of Homeroom bot's slots for changes up for a vote.

ai.short.tomorrow.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: held by today's limit on the project, so it waits for tomorrow.

ai.short.stalled.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: its build was due to start and has not.

ai.short.monday.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: on hold until Monday, when the week's building time resets.

ai.short.nobody.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: nobody is building it yet.

ai.short.yourPlan.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting: Homeroom bot waits for the person's plan for their own request before it builds it.

ai.short.waiting.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Waiting, when nothing more specific applies.

ai.short.private.description: Homeroom bot tab: the word on the right of a private thread's row (only the person can see it), and the heading, beside a lock, over private ideas that are in no project yet.

ai.short.today.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Live this week: it went live today.

ai.short.yesterday.description: The AI tab's main view: the one word at the right end of a one-line row in Live this week: it went live yesterday.

ai.why.decide.text: Homeroom bot needs a person to decide
ai.why.decide.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row Homeroom bot handed back for a person to decide.

ai.why.buildStopped.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Needs you row whose build by Homeroom bot stopped without a change.

ai.why.voteFreesSlot.text: Your vote helps free a build slot
ai.why.voteFreesSlot.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a vote on one of Homeroom bot's changes, where a request of yours waits for its build slot.

ai.why.heldYours_one.text: A vote you owe can free its slot
ai.why.heldYours_one.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Waiting row held for a build slot that one vote you owe can free.

ai.why.heldYours_other.text: {{count}} votes you owe can free its slot
ai.why.heldYours_other.description: Homeroom bot tab, on a phone: the second line of a Waiting row held for a build slot that votes you owe can free.

ai.ask.label.description: The AI tab's main view: the person's work with Homeroom bot across every project, beside Main, their private chat with it. The bar at the foot of the screen on a phone: opens Main, the private chat with Homeroom bot.

ai.main.sub.text: Only you can see this chat
ai.main.sub.description: The AI tab on a wide window: the line under the title "Main" over the person's private chat with Homeroom bot, docked beside their list of work, after a lock glyph. Says that nobody else can read it.

ai.main.new_one.description: The AI tab's list: on the right of its first row, Main Chat (the person's private chat with Homeroom bot), how many of its messages they have not read yet. Shown only when there is any.

ai.main.new_other.description: The AI tab's list: on the right of its first row, Main Chat (the person's private chat with Homeroom bot), how many of its messages they have not read yet. Shown only when there is any.

ai.thread.sub.text: Only you can see this thread
ai.thread.sub.description: The AI tab: the line under the name of one of the person's private threads with Homeroom bot, shown alone in the column where Main Chat goes (or a phone's drawer), after a lock glyph. Nothing in it is public until they file it or post it.

ai.thread.aboutRequest.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a request's page, and of its row in the list: the request's number and title, for example "#18 Dark mode".

ai.thread.aboutRequestUntitled.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a request's page, when the request's title is not known.

ai.thread.aboutChange.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a change's page: the change's number and title.

ai.thread.aboutChangeUntitled.description: The name over a private thread with Homeroom bot that was opened from a change's page, when the change's title is not known.

botCards.batch.title.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply when it works through several of a person's requests at once. {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.titleRunning.description: Title of that card once the person tapped Build: Homeroom bot is building the ready requests. {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.titleDone.description: Title of that card once nothing of the batch is being built any more (each is live, waiting for a yes, or stopped). {{project}} is the project's name.

botCards.batch.count.total_one.description: First part of the summary under the batch card's title, joined to the next parts with a dot: how many requests the card lists.

botCards.batch.count.total_other.description: First part of the summary under the batch card's title, joined to the next parts with a dot: how many requests the card lists.

botCards.batch.count.ready_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot found ready to build.

botCards.batch.count.ready_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot found ready to build.

botCards.batch.count.question_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests have a question from Homeroom bot waiting for an answer.

botCards.batch.count.question_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests have a question from Homeroom bot waiting for an answer.

botCards.batch.count.person_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot left for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.count.person_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot left for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.count.done_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already live, or need nothing built.

botCards.batch.count.done_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already live, or need nothing built.

botCards.batch.count.reading_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot is reading again now.

botCards.batch.count.reading_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot is reading again now.

botCards.batch.count.underway_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.count.underway_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests are already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.count.unread_one.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot could not read from here.

botCards.batch.count.unread_other.description: Part of the summary under the batch card's title: how many requests Homeroom bot could not read from here.

botCards.batch.read.ready.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot found it ready to build.

botCards.batch.read.question.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot asked a question about it that waits for an answer.

botCards.batch.read.person.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot left it for the project's group to decide.

botCards.batch.read.done.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: what it asks is live, or there was nothing to build.

botCards.batch.read.reading.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot is reading it again now.

botCards.batch.read.underway.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: it is already being built, checked or voted on.

botCards.batch.read.unread.description: Small tag at the end of a request's row on the batch card: Homeroom bot could not read it from here.

botCards.batch.why.plan.text: Its plan is ready: Build goes ahead with it.
botCards.batch.why.plan.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: Homeroom bot wrote its plan, and Build goes ahead with that plan.

botCards.batch.why.held.text: Ready, and waiting for a free slot.
botCards.batch.why.held.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: it is ready, but a limit on how much Homeroom bot builds at once held it.

botCards.batch.why.allowance.text: Its building time for this week is used up.
botCards.batch.why.allowance.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: whoever pays for it has no building time left this week.

botCards.batch.why.notBuiltHere.text: Homeroom bot does not build on this project.
botCards.batch.why.notBuiltHere.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card, when it could not be read because Homeroom bot is not switched on for the project.

botCards.batch.why.notMember.text: Only the project's members can ask for it to be read.
botCards.batch.why.notMember.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card, when the person is not a member of the project and did not file it.

botCards.batch.why.empty.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: Homeroom bot found nothing to build for it.

botCards.batch.why.live.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: what it asks for is live.

botCards.batch.why.vote.text: Its change waits for a yes.
botCards.batch.why.vote.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: its change is built and up for approval.

botCards.batch.why.checks.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: its change is built and its automated checks are running.

botCards.batch.why.building.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: Homeroom bot is building it now.

botCards.batch.why.goingLive.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: its change was approved and is going live.

botCards.batch.why.buildQueued.text: Waiting its turn to be built.
botCards.batch.why.buildQueued.description: Line under a request's title on the batch card: it is ready and its build waits its turn.

botCards.batch.untitled.description: A request's name on the batch card when its title is not known. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.batch.more_one.description: Button under the batch card's first rows: shows the rest of the requests.

botCards.batch.more_other.description: Button under the batch card's first rows: shows the rest of the requests.

botCards.batch.fewer.description: Button under the batch card's rows once all are shown: shows only the first few again.

botCards.batch.rollup.live_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title and its bar's name, joined with dots: how many of its requests are live.

botCards.batch.rollup.live_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title and its bar's name, joined with dots: how many of its requests are live.

botCards.batch.rollup.ready_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its changes are built and wait for approval.

botCards.batch.rollup.ready_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its changes are built and wait for approval.

botCards.batch.rollup.checks_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its changes are having their automated checks run.

botCards.batch.rollup.checks_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its changes are having their automated checks run.

botCards.batch.rollup.building_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its requests are being planned or built.

botCards.batch.rollup.building_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its requests are being planned or built.

botCards.batch.rollup.waiting_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its requests wait their turn, a limit, or an answer.

botCards.batch.rollup.waiting_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its requests wait their turn, a limit, or an answer.

botCards.batch.rollup.stopped_one.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its builds stopped without a change.

botCards.batch.rollup.stopped_other.description: Part of the line under a running batch card's title: how many of its builds stopped without a change.

botCards.batch.state.live.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: live.

botCards.batch.state.ready.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: its change is built and waits for approval.

botCards.batch.state.checks.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: its change's automated checks are running.

botCards.batch.state.building.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: it is being planned or built.

botCards.batch.state.waiting.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: it waits its turn, a limit, or an answer.

botCards.batch.state.stopped.description: Where one request of a running batch is, at the end of its row: its build stopped without a change.

botCards.batch.raise.offerOwner_one.text: As the project's owner, Build runs up to {{count}} of these at once for this batch.
botCards.batch.raise.offerOwner_one.description: Line on the batch card before Build is tapped: the project's owner may have more of Homeroom bot's work going at once for this batch than the usual limit. {{count}} is that number.

botCards.batch.raise.offerOwner_other.text: As the project's owner, Build runs up to {{count}} of these at once for this batch.
botCards.batch.raise.offerOwner_other.description: Line on the batch card before Build is tapped: the project's owner may have more of Homeroom bot's work going at once for this batch than the usual limit. {{count}} is that number.

botCards.batch.raise.offerAdmin_one.text: As one of the project's admins, Build runs up to {{count}} of these at once for this batch.
botCards.batch.raise.offerAdmin_one.description: Line on the batch card before Build is tapped, for an admin of the project: more of Homeroom bot's work may go at once for this batch than the usual limit. {{count}} is that number.

botCards.batch.raise.offerAdmin_other.text: As one of the project's admins, Build runs up to {{count}} of these at once for this batch.
botCards.batch.raise.offerAdmin_other.description: Line on the batch card before Build is tapped, for an admin of the project: more of Homeroom bot's work may go at once for this batch than the usual limit. {{count}} is that number.

botCards.batch.raise.runningOwner_one.text: {{count}} at once: your limit for this batch, as the project's owner.
botCards.batch.raise.runningOwner_one.description: Line on a running batch card: how many of its requests Homeroom bot works on at once, raised for this batch because the person owns the project.

botCards.batch.raise.runningOwner_other.text: {{count}} at once: your limit for this batch, as the project's owner.
botCards.batch.raise.runningOwner_other.description: Line on a running batch card: how many of its requests Homeroom bot works on at once, raised for this batch because the person owns the project.

botCards.batch.raise.runningAdmin_one.text: {{count}} at once: your limit for this batch, as one of the project's admins.
botCards.batch.raise.runningAdmin_one.description: Line on a running batch card: how many of its requests Homeroom bot works on at once, raised for this batch because the person is one of the project's admins.

botCards.batch.raise.runningAdmin_other.text: {{count}} at once: your limit for this batch, as one of the project's admins.
botCards.batch.raise.runningAdmin_other.description: Line on a running batch card: how many of its requests Homeroom bot works on at once, raised for this batch because the person is one of the project's admins.

botCards.batch.refused_one.description: Line on a running batch card: a request it found ready could not be started (its building time, or who may ask). {{numbers}} is the request, for example #4.

botCards.batch.refused_other.description: Line on a running batch card: requests it found ready could not be started (building time, or who may ask). {{numbers}} lists them, for example #4 and #9.

botCards.batch.choices.text: What to do with these requests
botCards.batch.choices.description: Accessible name of the row of buttons under the batch card.

botCards.batch.build_one.description: Button on the batch card: Homeroom bot starts building the one ready request.

botCards.batch.build_other.description: Button on the batch card: Homeroom bot starts building every ready request at once. {{count}} is how many.

botCards.batch.answer_one.description: Button on the batch card: Homeroom bot asks its open question about one of the requests, in the chat.

botCards.batch.answer_other.description: Button on the batch card: Homeroom bot asks its open questions about the requests, in the chat.

botCards.batch.close.description: Button on the batch card for a request that is done: Homeroom bot offers a vote on closing it. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.batch.say.answer_one.description: What the person says to Homeroom bot in the chat, as their own message, when they tap Answer the question on the batch card. {{numbers}} is the request, for example #3.

botCards.batch.say.answer_other.description: What the person says to Homeroom bot in the chat, as their own message, when they tap Answer the questions on the batch card. {{numbers}} lists the requests, for example #3 and #7.

botCards.batch.say.close.text: #{{number}} is done. Can you propose closing it?
botCards.batch.say.close.description: What the person says to Homeroom bot in the chat, as their own message, when they tap Close on the batch card. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.batch.failed.text: That did not work just now. Try again.
botCards.batch.failed.description: Error under the batch card's buttons when a tap could not be done and the server gave no reason.

botCards.buildNote.title.waiting.description: Title of the card under Homeroom bot's reply when the person added a note to a request it is building right now. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.title.delivered.text: The build of #{{number}} has your note
botCards.buildNote.title.delivered.description: Title of that card once the build has read the note. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.title.missed.description: Title of that card when the build ended before it read the note. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.title.forwarded.text: Your note goes into the next update
botCards.buildNote.title.forwarded.description: Title of that card once the person put the note in the change's next update.

botCards.buildNote.title.offerRedo.text: Stop the build of #{{number}} and start again?
botCards.buildNote.title.offerRedo.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot puts under its reply when the person wants a running build stopped and done again with their note. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.title.redone.description: Title of that card once the person tapped Stop and redo: the build was stopped and the request is done again. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.title.gone.description: Title of that card when the build ended before the person decided, so there is nothing to stop. {{number}} is the request's number.

botCards.buildNote.line.waiting.text: It reads it at its next step, before it finishes.
botCards.buildNote.line.waiting.description: Line on the build note card while the note waits for the running build to read it.

botCards.buildNote.line.missedChange.text: Its change is up for a vote. Put your note in its next update?
botCards.buildNote.line.missedChange.description: Line on the build note card when the build finished before reading the note and its change is up for approval: the button under it puts the note in the change's next update.

botCards.buildNote.line.missed.text: It ended before it read your note.
botCards.buildNote.line.missed.description: Line on the build note card when the build ended before reading the note and there is no change to update.

botCards.buildNote.line.forwarded.text: It goes into the next update instead. Your note is on the change's discussion.
botCards.buildNote.line.forwarded.description: Line on the build note card once the note was put in the change's next update: it is posted on the change's discussion under the person's name.

botCards.buildNote.line.offerRedo.text: Stop and redo stops it now. Your note goes on the request's discussion, under your name, and Homeroom bot reads the request again first. Keep going sends the note into this build instead.
botCards.buildNote.line.offerRedo.description: Line on the Stop and redo card, before anything is tapped: what each button does.

botCards.buildNote.line.redone.text: It stopped. Your note is on the request's discussion, and Homeroom bot reads the request again first.
botCards.buildNote.line.redone.description: Line on the build note card once Stop and redo was tapped and the note was posted on the request.

botCards.buildNote.line.redoneCarried.text: It stopped. Homeroom bot reads the request again, and its next build gets your note.
botCards.buildNote.line.redoneCarried.description: Line on the build note card once Stop and redo was tapped, when the note could not be posted on the request: the next build is handed it instead.

botCards.buildNote.redo.description: Button on the Stop and redo card: stops Homeroom bot's running build and does the request again with the person's note.

botCards.buildNote.keep.description: Button on the Stop and redo card: nothing stops, and the person's note is sent into the running build instead.

botCards.buildNote.forward.text: Put it in the next update
botCards.buildNote.forward.description: Button on the build note card when the build finished first: posts the note on the change's discussion so Homeroom bot puts it in the change's next update.

botCards.buildNote.choices.text: What to do with the build
botCards.buildNote.choices.description: Accessible name of the row of buttons on the build note card.

botCards.buildNote.failed.text: That did not work just now. Try again.
botCards.buildNote.failed.description: Error under the build note card's buttons when a tap could not be done and the server gave no reason.
